cases.name: Ronda Christine Ebeling
cases.about:
Ebeling’s mother, Debi Jolley, said her daughter was the kind of person who could do anything. She was a funeral attendant and worked in transportation and retrieval with the coroner’s office as well as being a published photographer and model.

HER OBITUARY SAID "She worked at Wiefels Mortuary and volunteered with the San Bernardino Coroner’s Office.

In her short life she modeled, did stunt work, was in four magazines, in one Western episode and reenacted fight scenes. She loved swinging in the air with acrobats, bungee jumping, repelling down mountainsides, snorkeling in underwater caves and exploring mines — finding places untouched for years and always taking pictures but never revealing the location.

She had a love for animals, raised chicken and quails, and never turned away any strays."
